DecidableEqAlt.content:
class DecidableEqAlt (A : Type u) where
  decEq : (x y : A) → Bool

ZeroAlt.content:
class ZeroAlt (A : Type u) where
  zero : A

OneAlt.content:
class OneAlt (A : Type u) where
  one : A

Preorder.content:
class Preorder (A : Type u) where
  le    : A → A → Prop
  refl  : ∀ x, le x x
  trans : ∀ {x y z}, le x y → le y z → le x z

ZeroLEOneClass.content:
class ZeroLEOneClass (A : Type u) [ZeroAlt A] [OneAlt A] [Preorder A] : Prop where
  zero_le_one  : (ZeroAlt.zero : A) ≤ (OneAlt.one : A)
  zero_le_zero : (ZeroAlt.zero : A) ≤ (ZeroAlt.zero : A)

α.content: variable (α : Type u) [ZeroAlt α] [OneAlt α] [Preorder α] [ZeroLEOneClass α]

One_matrix.content:
def One_matrix : matrix m α :=
    fun i j => if DecidableEqAlt.decEq i j then OneAlt.one else ZeroAlt.zero

zero_le_one_elem.content:
theorem zero_le_one_elem
  (i j : m) : (ZeroAlt.zero : α) ≤ One_matrix m α i j :=
by
  cases h : DecidableEqAlt.decEq i j with
  | true  =>
      simpa [One_matrix, h]
        using (ZeroLEOneClass.zero_le_one : (ZeroAlt.zero : α) ≤ (OneAlt.one : α))
  | false =>
      simpa [One_matrix, h]
        using (ZeroLEOneClass.zero_le_zero : (ZeroAlt.zero : α) ≤ (ZeroAlt.zero : α))

Zero_matrix.content: def Zero_matrix : matrix m α := fun _ _ => ZeroAlt.zero

matrix_le.content: def matrix_le (A B : matrix m α) : Prop := ∀ i j, A i j ≤ B i j

Zero_le_One_matrix.content:
theorem Zero_le_One_matrix : matrix_le m α (Zero_matrix m α) (One_matrix m α) :=
by
  intro i j
  cases h : DecidableEqAlt.decEq i j with
  | true  =>
      simpa [Zero_matrix, One_matrix, h]
        using (ZeroLEOneClass.zero_le_one : (ZeroAlt.zero : α) ≤ (OneAlt.one : α))
  | false =>
      simpa [Zero_matrix, One_matrix, h]
        using (ZeroLEOneClass.zero_le_zero : (ZeroAlt.zero : α) ≤ (ZeroAlt.zero : α))

matrix_le_refl.content:
theorem matrix_le_refl (A : matrix m α) : matrix_le m α A A :=
by
  intro i j; exact Preorder.refl (A i j)

matrix_le_trans.content:
theorem matrix_le_trans (A B C : matrix m α) :
    matrix_le m α A B → matrix_le m α B C → matrix_le m α A C :=
by
  intro HAB HBC i j
  exact Preorder.trans (HAB i j) (HBC i j)

matrix_eq.content: def matrix_eq (A B : matrix m α) : Prop := ∀ i j, A i j = B i j

matrix_eq_refl.content: theorem matrix_eq_refl (A : matrix m α) : matrix_eq m α A A := by intro _ _; rfl

matrix_eq_sym.content:
theorem matrix_eq_sym (A B : matrix m α) : matrix_eq m α A B → matrix_eq m α B A :=
by
  intro h i j; symm; exact h i j

matrix_eq_trans.content:
theorem matrix_eq_trans (A B C : matrix m α) :
    matrix_eq m α A B → matrix_eq m α B C → matrix_eq m α A C :=
by
  intro hAB hBC i j
  calc
    A i j = B i j := hAB i j
    _ = C i j := hBC i j

matrix_eq_le.content:
theorem matrix_eq_le (A B : matrix m α) :
    matrix_eq m α A B → matrix_le m α A B ∧ matrix_le m α B A :=
by
  intro Heq
  constructor
  · intro i j; have := Heq i j; simpa [this]
    using (Preorder.refl (B i j))
  · intro i j; have := Heq i j; simpa [this]
    using (Preorder.refl (A i j))

PartialOrder.content:
class PartialOrder (A : Type u) [Preorder A] : Prop where
  le_antisym : ∀ {x y : A}, x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y

matrix_le_antisymm.content:
theorem matrix_le_antisymm (A B : matrix m α) :
    matrix_le m α A B → matrix_le m α B A → matrix_eq m α A B :=
by
  intro HAB HBA i j
  apply PartialOrder.le_antisym
  · exact HAB i j
  · exact HBA i j

Preorder.trans.content: trans : ∀ {x y z}, le x y → le y z → le x z

PartialOrder.le_antisym.content: le_antisym : ∀ {x y : A}, x ≤ y → y ≤ x → x = y

One_matrix.content:
Definition One_matrix : matrix :=
    fun i j => if dec_eq i j then one else zero.

zero_le_one_elem.content:
Lemma zero_le_one_elem (i j : m) :
    zero ≤ (One_matrix : matrix) i j.
  Proof.
    unfold One_matrix; simpl.
    destruct (dec_eq i j) as [->|neq].
    - apply zero_le_one.
    - apply zero_le_zero.
  Qed.

matrix_le.content:
Definition matrix_le (A B : matrix) : Prop :=
    forall i j, A i j ≤ B i j.

Zero_le_One_matrix.content:
Lemma Zero_le_One_matrix : Zero_matrix ≤ₘ One_matrix.
  Proof.
    unfold matrix_le, Zero_matrix; intros i j.
    unfold One_matrix; simpl.
    destruct (dec_eq i j) as [->|neq].
    - apply zero_le_one.
    - apply zero_le_zero.
  Qed.

matrix_le_refl.content:
Lemma matrix_le_refl (A : matrix) : A ≤ₘ A.
  Proof.
    unfold matrix_le; intros i j; apply Preorder_Reflexive.
  Qed.

matrix_le_trans.content:
Lemma matrix_le_trans (A B C : matrix) :
    A ≤ₘ B -> B ≤ₘ C -> A ≤ₘ C.
  Proof.
    intros HAB HBC i j.
    apply Preorder_Transitive with (y := B i j); [apply HAB | apply HBC].
  Qed.

matrix_eq.content:
Definition matrix_eq (A B : matrix) : Prop :=
    forall i j, A i j = B i j.

matrix_eq_refl.content:
Lemma matrix_eq_refl (A : matrix) : A ≃ₘ A.
  Proof.
    unfold matrix_eq; intros i j; reflexivity.
  Qed.

matrix_eq_sym.content:
Lemma matrix_eq_sym (A B : matrix) : A ≃ₘ B -> B ≃ₘ A.
  Proof.
    unfold matrix_eq; intros Ha i j; symmetry; apply Ha.
  Qed.

matrix_eq_trans.content:
Lemma matrix_eq_trans (A B C : matrix) :
    A ≃ₘ B -> B ≃ₘ C -> A ≃ₘ C.
  Proof.
    unfold matrix_eq; intros HAB HBC i j.
    etransitivity; [apply HAB| apply HBC].
  Qed.

matrix_eq_le.content:
Lemma matrix_eq_le (A B : matrix) :
    A ≃ₘ B -> A ≤ₘ B /\ B ≤ₘ A.
  Proof.
    intro Heq; split.
    - unfold matrix_le; intros i j.
      rewrite <- (Heq i j); apply Preorder_Reflexive.
    - unfold matrix_le; intros i j.
      rewrite   (Heq i j); apply Preorder_Reflexive.
  Qed.

matrix_le_antisymm.content:
Lemma matrix_le_antisymm (A B : matrix) :
    A ≤ₘ B -> B ≤ₘ A -> A ≃ₘ B.
  Proof.
    intros HAB HBA i j.
    apply (@le_antisym α H2 PO); [apply (HAB i j) | apply (HBA i j)].
  Qed.

dec_eq.content: dec_eq : forall x y : A, {x = y} + {x <> y}

Preorder_Reflexive.content: Preorder_Reflexive  : forall x,       le x x;

Preorder_Transitive.content: Preorder_Transitive : forall x y z,   le x y -> le y z -> le x z

le_antisym.content: le_antisym : forall x y, x ≤ y -> y ≤ x -> x = y
